claim: Killing a selftest leaves worker processes, so kill the auto child's PID too and never use pkill -f; a wait loop built on kill -0 $(pgrep -o -f X) is the same warned pattern.

evidence.text: Killing a selftest needs its auto child's PID too (never pkill -f).
Killing a selftest leaves its worker processes: kill them by PID.
A wait loop written as kill -0 $(pgrep -o -f X) is the warned pattern in a new form.
